english: Let $S$ be the sphere $x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=25$ and let $Q$ be the point $(6,7,6)$. For a real number $d$ with $|d|<55$, the plane $6x+7y+6z=d$ cuts $S$ in a circle $C_{d}$. Among all right circular cones with vertex $Q$ and base $C_{d}$, the cone of maximum volume is obtained for $d$ equal to ______.
hindi: माना कि $S$ गोला $x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=25$ है तथा $Q$ बिन्दु $(6,7,6)$ है। किसी वास्तविक संख्या $d$, $|d|<55$, के लिए तल $6x+7y+6z=d$ गोले $S$ को एक वृत्त $C_{d}$ में काटता है। शीर्ष $Q$ तथा आधार $C_{d}$ वाले सभी लम्ब वृत्तीय शंकुओं में से अधिकतम आयतन वाला शंकु $d$ के ______ के बराबर होने पर प्राप्त होता है।
solution: $|\overrightarrow{OQ}|=\sqrt{36+49+36}=11$ and the plane's normal is along $\overrightarrow{OQ}$, so $Q$ lies on the axis of $C_{d}$; the centre of $C_{d}$ is at signed distance $u=\dfrac{d}{11}$ from $O$ towards $Q$, $u\in(-5,5)$.
$\dfrac{dV}{du}=\dfrac{\pi}{3}\left(3u^{2}-22u-25\right)=\dfrac{\pi}{3}(3u-25)(u+1)$; in $(-5,5)$ only $u=-1$, where $V'$ changes from $+$ to $-$: maximum.
solution_full: The centre of $S$ is $O(0,0,0)$ and its radius is $5$. $|\overrightarrow{OQ}|=\sqrt{6^{2}+7^{2}+6^{2}}=11>5$, so $Q$ is outside $S$.

The normal of the plane $6x+7y+6z=d$ is $(6,7,6)$, parallel to $\overrightarrow{OQ}$. The centre of $C_{d}$ is the foot of the perpendicular from $O$, $\dfrac{d}{121}(6,7,6)$, at signed distance $u=\dfrac{d}{11}$ from $O$ along $\overrightarrow{OQ}$. So $O$, the centre of $C_{d}$ and $Q$ are collinear on the axis of $C_{d}$, and every such cone is right circular.
The plane cuts $S$ iff $|u|<5$, i.e. $|d|<55$. Radius of $C_{d}$: $r^{2}=25-u^{2}$. Height of the cone (distance from $Q$ to the plane): $11-u$.
$V'(u)=\dfrac{\pi}{3}\left(3u^{2}-22u-25\right)=\dfrac{\pi}{3}(3u-25)(u+1)$. The root $u=\dfrac{25}{3}$ is outside $(-5,5)$, so the only critical point is $u=-1$.
$V'>0$ on $(-5,-1)$ and $V'<0$ on $(-1,5)$, so $u=-1$ gives the maximum volume $V=\dfrac{\pi}{3}\cdot24\cdot12=96\pi$ (the base lies on the far side of the centre from $Q$).
originality_note: New: cones with a fixed external vertex over the parallel sections of a sphere, parametrised by the plane constant d in coordinates (way 5). Closest known: maximum volume of a cone inscribed in a sphere (vertex on the sphere, height 4R/3). Different because: the vertex is outside the sphere at distance 11, the optimum section lies beyond the centre (u = -1), and the answer is the plane's constant d.

key_step: Parametrise by the signed distance u = d/11 of the cutting plane from the centre and maximise (25 - u^2)(11 - u).
justification: Routine optimisation once the sphere-section geometry is set up (three standard steps, one cubic derivative); L2 numerical, between the L1 and L3 3D anchors 2024-P2-Q6 and 2026-P1-Q6.
